items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: now I play mostly with this fellow. He always come get me to play with him going out in the country, you know. They call him Doc.

ctx.x: Yes, I know sometimes they have music in there.

Sometimes I used to play the piano in the spiritual church, but then I'd just wait till they sing whatever they sing and pick it up, you see, and go on with them. You see, that's the way I'd do. Of course, they wouldn't have no music. They don't have no music, but I used to go around there when I was kind of, you know, before it got operated on, I used to go play in the churches, you know, and help them out because I haven't been playing much otherwise, but I'd get a job with this, this, now I play mostly with…
